item.title: Jacory Dante McCalpin sentenced to more than 106 years after conviction by jury on 27 counts of criminal sexual conduct and stalking
item.description:
Publication Date: June 30, 2026

McCalpin received 1,276-month sentence following multiple sexual assaults between July 2022 and December 2023
